### All-Pervading Opposites
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/all-pervading-opposites
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:1
Points:
- Solomon breaks down life into measurable events, presenting fourteen contrasting pairs of experiences.
- Evaluated on a purely horizontal level apart from God, these opposing seasons seem to cancel out into empty futility.
- Secular education and human wisdom can help formulate life's questions, but they cannot explain where life is going.
- Leaving God out of life's daily cycles turns both joyful and sorrowful times into a meaningless loop.

### To Everything There Is a Season
Author: Michelle S. Lazurek
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/to-everything-there-is-a-season-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 3:1
Points:
- Life continually transitions through different stages, requiring us to grieve endings while welcoming new beginnings.
- Just as farmers endure planting and cultivating to reach harvest, life requires enduring difficult phases to produce growth.
- Hardships and trials are purposeful seasons that God uses to refine believers into Christlikeness.
- We can embrace each season patiently, knowing that painful times will eventually yield to new life.
